titel: Design and Validation of a Robotic Knee Exoskeleton with Musculoskeletal Simulation-Derived Biological Torque Control
text: Data-driven controllers have enabled lower-limb robotic exoskeletons to adapt assistance to the user across many tasks. A leading example is biological torque control, which estimates the user's own joint moment from onboard sensors and assists in proportion to that estimate. However, its estimators are trained on data recorded with the target device, so deploying the controller on new hardware requires collecting new data. titel: SketchMate: Agentic Geometric Reasoning for Zero-Shot Precision Insertion
text: Inserting an unseen part requires sub-millimetre precision and the correct orientation of keyed features. Current zero-shot agentic manipulation methods built on vision-language models (VLMs) produce spatial outputs that are far too coarse for this. We propose to let a VLM build a sketch model of the task, i.e., a few geometric primitives and two mate frames, which a VLM agent measures with geometric tools in multi-view depth and which a standard planner and compliant controller execute. was: Forschungsarbeit zu VLM-gestützter Präzisionsmontage: Ein Vision-Language-Modell erstellt ein Skizzenmodell der Fügeaufgabe, das mit Geometriewerkzeugen vermessen und mit Standardplanung und nachgiebiger Regelung ausgeführt wird. Der Eintrag ist abgeschnitten.
berryroad: Berührt Präzisionsfügen und Zero-Shot-Manipulation, also Themen rund um Physical AI. Die Reife ist nur Labor-Niveau und der Eintrag belegt keine Ergebnisse im Mittelstand.

titel: Pinching Antennas for ISAC: Waveguide Architectures, Solutions, and Future Directions
text: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) is a core design principle for sixth-generation (6G) wireless systems, yet fixed antenna geometry limits its performance. Pinching antenna systems (PASS) guide electromagnetic waves along dielectric waveguides and radiate them through position-adaptive antennas, allowing communication links and sensing observations to benefit from spatial reconfiguration. was: Übersichtsartikel zu Pinching Antennas für integrierte Sensorik und Kommunikation in 6G-Systemen.

titel: When the Past Shapes Action: Understanding Embodied Memory
text: Recent advances in generative foundation models have expanded the capabilities of embodied AI, enabling increasingly general navigation, manipulation, and long-horizon task execution. However, effective interaction with dynamic environments requires more than only strong perception and reasoning: agents must act with partial knowledge and retain, retrieve, and update information from past observations, actions, and experiences. was: Übersichtsarbeit zu Embodied Memory, also dem Speichern und Abrufen vergangener Beobachtungen bei verkörperten KI-Agenten.
berryroad: Allgemeine Grundlagenforschung zu Robotern ohne Fertigungsbezug. Für Berryroad höchstens Hintergrundwissen.

titel: Learning from Physical Experience:Context-Space Adaptation for Robotic Manipulation
text: Recent multimodal foundation models exhibit strong perception, reasoning, and in-context learning capabilities, but translating these capabilities into physical action remains challenging. Through real-world experiments across diverse manipulation tasks, we find that ChatGPT-6-Astra, a state-of-the-art general-purpose reasoner, can serve as a physically actionable, context-responsive manipulation policy, demonstrating effective fine manipulation and spatial reasoning. Building on these findings, we introduce LEXP, a harness for learning from physical experience through context-space adaptation
was: Arbeit zu LEXP, einem Ansatz, bei dem ein allgemeines Sprachmodell über Kontextanpassung aus physischer Erfahrung lernt und Manipulationsaufgaben ausführt. Die Ergebnisse stammen aus Einzelexperimenten.
berryroad: Die Praxistauglichkeit für wiederholbare Industrieprozesse ist nicht belegt. Der Ansatz ist eher ein Signal für Foundation-Model-Robotik als für ein Angebot.

titel: STAR: Steering Action Representations during Inference
text: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) map language instructions and visual observations to robot actions, showing strong capabilities across robotic manipulation tasks. However, in our probing experiment, we find that action representations near the action output do not fully preserve task-relevant visual grounding. Motivated by this late-layer grounding gap, we introduce STAR, for STeering Action Representations, a training-free inference method for pre-trained VLAs. was: STAR ist ein trainingsfreies Verfahren, das die Aktionsrepräsentationen bestehender Vision-Language-Action-Modelle zur Laufzeit glättet.

titel: From Teleoperation to Long-Horizon Dexterity: Evaluating Visuomotor Skills and Offline Proxies for Dexterous Manipulation
text: Imitation learning policies are intended to make robotic manipulation robust to variations in object pose, appearance, and environment that challenge pre-programmed motion. However, real-world performance remains difficult to predict, as conventional optimization signals such as validation loss show no consistent relationship with robot success. was: Studie mit 281 Imitation-Learning-Policies und rund 1.700 Roboterversuchen zum Greifen und Stecken von RJ45-Steckern mit fünffingriger Hand.

titel: CaPtain: A Pipeline for Post-Training Code-as-Policy Robot Agents
text: Across coding, web, and tool-use tasks, language-model agents are now routinely trained with the same recipe: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to learn the interface, then multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) to master it. Code-as-policy (CaP) casts robot manipulation in the same form, as the policy writes code against robot APIs and reads back the results, so the same recipe should apply. was: CaPtain ist eine Pipeline, mit der kleine Sprachmodelle als Code-Policy-Agenten für Roboter per SFT und Reinforcement Learning trainiert werden.

titel: Visuo-tactile Diffusion Policy for Robotic Manipulation with Auxiliary Tactile Dynamics Prediction

titel: DexArena: A Unified Benchmark for Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation
text: Long-horizon dexterous manipulation remains a fundamental challenge for robot learning, requiring the composition of multiple skills, precise bimanual coordination, generalizable visual understanding, and robust skill transitions. Yet existing manipulation benchmarks largely emphasize isolated skills or support only a limited range of end-effectors, making these capabilities difficult to evaluate systematically. titel: 3D Neural Rendering for Automated Ultrasonic Laser Scans

was: Serving-Verfahren für Roboter-Policies, das statt Caching von Denoising-Zuständen einfach weniger Denoising-Schritte aus frischem Rauschen nutzt. Ziel ist geringere Latenz und höherer Durchsatz bei mehreren Robotern.

text: Collaborative robots (cobots) are designed to be safer and more interactive than traditional industrial robots, share the same workspace as humans, and assist them in a range of shop-floor tasks such as palletization, joint assembly, and part inspection. Many of these tasks involve repetitive workflows that may evolve with changes in production environments and task specifications. was: Dialogbasiertes Teach-Verfahren für kollaborative Roboter, bei dem Werker Abläufe im Dialog ändern und abstrahieren, damit sie wiederverwendet werden können. Ziel sind Palettierung, Montage und Prüfung.

was: Systematische Übersichtsarbeit (PRISMA, 119 Volltexte) zur semantischen Interoperabilität föderierter digitaler Zwillinge. Ergebnis: Mappings werden in allen 32 Studien vor dem Betrieb festgelegt, eine Laufzeitreparatur existiert nicht.

titel: GURU: A Hierarchical Neuro-Symbolic Multi-Agent System for Verification-Aware Automation of Mission-Critical Digital Engineering and Operations
text: An AI can find a safe action faster than any human, but it must never decide what counts as safe. We present GURU, a hierarchical neuro-symbolic multi-agent system for mission-critical digital engineering and operations, built on one partition of authority: learned models propose, rank, and accelerate; a symbolic rules engine checks every consequential action against hard limits before it executes; and validated physics confirms and decides. GURU runs a workflow as a closed control loop, with Navigation, Action, and Planning agents sharing one Common Internal Language and one training factory.
was: Hierarchisches neuro-symbolisches Multi-Agenten-System für missionskritische digitale Technik und Betrieb, mit symbolischer Regelprüfung vor jeder Aktion. Der Eintrag bleibt in der Beschreibung allgemein.

text: Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Network Digital Twins (NDTs) are increasingly combined to form Cognitive Digital Twins (CDTs) that translate operational intents into network changes and support closed-loop management. However, a network change may achieve its intended objective while disrupting the monitoring or recovery mechanisms needed for subsequent decisions. For example, a service may be rerouted while its latency-monitoring traffic continues along the original path, producing measurements that no longer reflect the service's performance. was: Closed-Loop-Absicherung für agentische KI in kognitiven Netzwerk-Zwillingen. Es geht um Netzwerkänderungen, die Überwachungsmechanismen stören können.
berryroad: Netzwerkmanagement, kein Fertigungsbezug. Nur als Randnotiz zur Absicherung agentischer KI relevant.

titel: DEPLOY-RL: Active Boundary Discovery and Conservative Certification for Deployable Reinforcement Learning in Safety-Critical Continuous Processes
text: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies often outperform classical controllers in simulation, yet rarely reach production in safety-critical processes. The barrier is that there is no principled way to answer "Is this policy safe to deploy?" with statistical guarantees. text: The energy transition causes a growing number of distributed flexible energy resources in the low voltage grid. titel: Integrating Machine Learning and Uncertainty Quantification for Real-Time Decision-Making in Digital Twins: A System-Centric Review and Perspective
text: Digital Twins are evolving from passive virtual representations into closed-loop systems that continuously synchronize with physical assets and drive real-time decisions. Yet predictive modeling, machine learning (ML), uncertainty quantification (UQ), and decision-making have been studied as separate capabilities, leaving limited understanding of their integration and maintenance during online operation. was: Narratives Review zu Integration von Machine Learning und Unsicherheitsquantifizierung für Entscheidungen in Echtzeit bei Digitalen Zwillingen.

Egocentric human videos offer a scalable substitute, but overlaying rendered robots on human videos or retargeting human poses into robot actions leaves significant visual or action gaps for high-DoF robot embodiments. text: Hierarchical pipelines for humanoid loco-manipulation typically pair a task-agnostic whole-body controller (WBC) with a downstream task policy. Such WBCs are often trained through manual reward shaping, which yields visibly machine-like motions; more consequentially, they are trained without the manipulated object in the scene. titel: CRONOS: Benchmarking Non-Episodic Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation
text: Reinforcement learning (RL) is promising for adapting robot policies to unstructured real-world environments. However, standard RL pipelines rely on episodic training with frequent scene resets, which is impractical for real-world deployment due to the need for substantial human intervention. While prior work has studied non-episodic RL in relatively small policies trained from scratch, its behavior when fine-tuning modern large-scale pre-trained vision-language-action (VLA) models remains underexplored. text: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated body motion and hand interaction over time, and a plausible-looking command sequence can still drop a held object or leave an interaction incomplete. text: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved promising performance for generalized robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on expensive real-robot data remains a fundamental bottleneck.
